main_text.p: Probris exponere, exprobrare. Ithpahel אתחסר Probris, convitiis affici.
חסיד, חסיד Ch.Sanctus, Benignus, Beneficus, miseri-cors. Plur. חסידין. חסידיא. Fœm. חסידא, emph. חסידתא Gratiosa, Prov.11.16.
חסורא, חסור Ch.Probrum, opprobrium, exprobratio. Plur. חסורין, חסורי, & fœm. חסורן, Psal.79.12.
חסרא, חסר Ch. ܚܣܪܐ Syr.Idem. Item Benignitas, Beneficentia, Gratia, Misericordia, Sanctitas, Pietas. Plural. חסרין.
חסח חסחף Ch. Tegere, contegere, protegere, Deut. 32.11. in Targ. Hierof. Corruptum videtur pro מחפחף, aut מחופף.
חסך Ch. & Syr. Cohibere, Subtrahere, Subtrahi. Scribitur aliquando per ש. Ethpehal Partic. Subtracti fuissem, Act.27.21.
חסיך Ch.Attenuatum, extenuatum, macilentum. Fœmin. חסיכתא. Plural. חסיכן.
חסוך Ch. Idem. Ezech.16.47. Item Cohibitio, subtractio poenæ, Clementia, Jer.30.11.& 46.v.ult.

חסל חסיל Ch.Complere, absolvere, finire, cessare, finiri, compleri, consumi, absumi, deficere: Item Maturare, ad maturitatem producere, Num. 17.23. in Targ.Hierof. Item Ablactare, 1.Sam.1.24. 1.Reg.11.20. Aphel אחסיל Cessare facere, absumere, consumere, absolvere, absolutè continere, capere.

page.notes: Hebrew and Syriac words are reproduced as far as legible; the Syriac and some pointed Hebrew forms in the scan are partly blurred and approximate. Several Hebrew and Chaldee lines are set in a smaller, heavier type and may be imprecise. The Hebrew-letter headwords at line starts are printed in larger type.
